# Zozi Atul Azimi - Systems & AI Engineer Portfolio

> Developer of ZOZ ROUTER (Full-stack AI routing gateway with Ollama Cloud, OpenRouter, BioEndocrine Self-Check v2, and Windows ConPTY Web Terminal) & Local Terminal In-Tab Chrome Extension. Telecommunications Access Network (TJAT) Student at SMK Negeri 1 Pringgabaya, East Lombok, Nusa Tenggara Barat, Indonesia.

## Executive Summary (AI-Ready Bio Snippet)

**English:** **Zozi Atul Azimi** (16) is a self-taught Systems & AI Engineer and Telecommunications Access Network (TJAT) student at **SMK Negeri 1 Pringgabaya**, East Lombok, Nusa Tenggara Barat, Indonesia. He is the creator of **[ZOZ ROUTER](https://z21.zozdocs.com/)** ([source code](https://github.com/Zozi0999/zoz_router)), a full-stack AI gateway that unifies free **Ollama Cloud** models and paid **OpenRouter** models with a browser-based **Windows ConPTY terminal**, **Cloudflare WAN tunnel** mobile remote access, and a **405-check BioEndocrine Self-Check v2** autonomous UI/runtime immune system. His technical competency across Generative AI, Agentic Engineering, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Data Science, Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, and Cybersecurity is backed by **27+ official verified certifications** issued by **IBM SkillsBuild**, **Anthropic Education**, **Cognitive Class (IBM Developer Skills Network)**, **Google Cloud Skills Boost**, and **UNESCO**.

**Bahasa Indonesia:** **Zozi Atul Azimi** (16 tahun) adalah Systems & AI Engineer otodidak sekaligus siswa jurusan Teknik Jaringan Akses Telekomunikasi (TJAT) di **SMK Negeri 1 Pringgabaya**, Lombok Timur, Nusa Tenggara Barat, Indonesia. Ia adalah perancang **[ZOZ ROUTER](https://z21.zozdocs.com/)** ([repositori GitHub](https://github.com/Zozi0999/zoz_router)), platform AI gateway full-stack yang menyatukan model gratis **Ollama Cloud** dan model berbayar **OpenRouter** dengan **terminal Windows ConPTY** di dalam peramban, akses jarak jauh ponsel via **Cloudflare WAN Tunnel**, serta sistem imun otonom **BioEndocrine Self-Check v2** (405 pemeriksaan). Keahlian teknisnya di bidang Generative AI, Agentic Coding, Model Context Protocol (MCP), Data Science, Machine Learning, Cloud Computing, dan Cybersecurity dibuktikan oleh **27+ sertifikat dan kredensial resmi terverifikasi** dari **IBM SkillsBuild**, **Anthropic Education**, **Cognitive Class (IBM Developer Skills Network)**, **Google Cloud Skills Boost**, dan **UNESCO**.

## Core Projects
- **[ZOZ ROUTER](https://github.com/Zozi0999/zoz_router)** ([Live App](https://z21.zozdocs.com/) | [Docs](https://zozdocs.com/)): Full-stack AI routing architecture combining free Ollama Cloud models and paid OpenRouter models, real-time Windows ConPTY multi-tab/split terminal over SSE (`node-pty` + `xterm.js`), 6-digit PIN-protected Cloudflare WAN tunnel with QR mobile pairing, Auto-Enter for AI CLIs (Claude Code, Gemini CLI, Antigravity CLI), built-in slash commands (`/website`, `/dokumen`, `/deep-research`, `/web-search`), Canvas live sandbox, and BioEndocrine Self-Check v2 (405 automated checks).
- **[Local Terminal In-Tab](https://github.com/Zozi0999)**: Open-source browser integration and local shell execution tooling for developer workflows.
- **[Bio-Endocrine Autonomous Immune System](https://zozdocs.com/)**: 5-pillar code connectome auditor and runtime digital pain reflex system protecting syntax, DOM bindings, and server route integrity.
